intent_contract.text: 첨부한 이미지의 외모에 어울리는 주사기를 든 얀데레 간호사 컨셉 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘.
첨부한 이미지는 얼굴만 참고하고 구도는 자유롭게 해줘.

Create a photographic adult yandere-nurse concept whose obsessive affection is visible through one target-directed act, one involuntary affect leak, and its immediate consequence, while using the attachment only for the nurse's facial appearance and leaving composition free.

Create a cinematic clinical portrait of an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties as a private-duty nurse, preserving only the attached reference’s facial appearance—oval face, pale complexion, ash-blonde hair, gray eyes, soft straight brows, and full pink lips—while freely redesigning pose and composition. In a spotless after-hours treatment room, she holds a capped syringe beside the intact sleeve of one clearly adult patient identified by a cobalt wristband. Her tender professional smile is meant for that same patient as she quietly turns the door lock with her free hand. A brief tremor in her smile is the single affect leak, revealing possessive devotion at the instant the lock clicks; the red locked indicator already glows and the patient’s hand has tightened around the chair arm. Keep the same cobalt wristband visible in the reflection for continuity. Use cool fluorescent ambience, a warm exam lamp, shallow depth of field, and crisp editorial realism.

obligations.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, and styling. Make the character the dominant first-look subject. In one still, connect one identifiable adult affection target or repeated marker of that same target to genuine tenderness, one concrete possessive or threatening action that crosses a personal boundary or appropriates access, and one already-visible consequence that changes that same target's access or choices. Make three outward channels coexist directly on the character: an affiliative face signal such as an adoring mouth or flushed cheek; target-locked eye-head-body attention; and ecstatic or barely controlled instability visible in the eyes, asymmetric smile, jaw, grip, or forward posture. Direct camera gaze is appropriate when the camera is the beloved's point of view. Non-graphic blood, a visible weapon, a syringe, red clinical light, or a heart motif may amplify the requested intensity and must not be automatically suppressed, but no single prop or styling cue may substitute for obsessive love toward the same target. Permit fictional threat without graphic wounds, gore, dismemberment, active injection or penetration, self-harm, sexualized vulnerability, real-person stalking, or instructional wrongdoing.
